g1.label: 1. Point of view of the story
g1.why: The narrator uses 'I', so the story is told in the first person.

g2.correct: because her style was different from everyone else's
accept: because her style was different from everyone else's
g2.label: 2. Why the narrator felt unwelcome
g2.why: She stood out because her style did not match the other students'.

g3.label: 3. 'as welcome as a wolf at a birthday party'
g3.why: A comparison using 'as…as' or 'like' is a simile.

g4.label: 4. The paragraph about the day of the move
g4.why: It jumps back to an earlier event, which is a flashback.

g5.label: 5. 'this ordinary Tuesday was going to change everything'
g5.why: Hinting at what will happen later in the story is foreshadowing.

g6.correct: he didn't fit the school's usual style either
accept: he didn't fit the school's usual style either
g6.label: 6. Why the boy with green hair stood out
g6.why: Like the narrator, he did not match the school's usual style.

g1.label: 1. 'I could feel my hands shaking…'
g1.why: The narrator speaks as 'I', so this is first-person narration.

g2.label: 2. 'She didn't say anything, but her eyes…'
g2.why: 'She' and 'him' show an outside narrator: third person.

g3.label: 3. 'My legs felt like jelly…'
g3.why: 'Like jelly' compares two things using 'like', so it is a simile.

g4.label: 4. 'Three years before that night…'
g4.why: The narrative moves back to an earlier time: a flashback.

g5.label: 5. 'If only she had known what waited…'
g5.why: It hints at something bad to come, which is foreshadowing.

g6.label: 6. 'smelled of stale coffee… lights buzzed'
g6.why: Descriptive detail appealing to the senses is imagery.

g8.label: 8. 'He turned the corner…'
g8.why: The narrator describes 'he' from outside: third person.

g1.label: 1. It ___ all week
g1.why: Past perfect shows the rain happened before the main past events.

g2.label: 2. so the skate park ___
g2.why: The main narrative uses the past simple for the resulting state.

g3.label: 3. I ___ skating before
g3.why: Past perfect with 'never… before' describes experience up to that past moment.

g4.label: 4. and I definitely ___
g4.why: The past simple carries the main action of the story.

g5.label: 5. While I ___ a group of older kids
g5.why: Past progressive sets the longer background action after 'while'.

g6.label: 6. someone ___
g6.why: The past simple marks the short action that interrupts the background one.

g7.label: 7. He ___ me from school
g7.why: The past simple states a fact at that point in the story.

g8.label: 8. even though we ___
g8.why: Past perfect refers back to the time before they met.
